notes: Run with the formpdf engine and window open (./formpdf) and the formpdf MCP server connected. Fixture paths are examples.

evals.name: number-and-watermark-the-open-pdf
evals.prompt: Add page numbers like 'Page 3 of 12' bottom right and a light DRAFT watermark to the PDF I have open.
expected_behavior: Calls get_context and uses the open PDF without asking for a path
One pdf page_numbers call with format 'Page {n} of {total}' and position bottom-right, one pdf watermark call with text DRAFT and a low opacity
Calls render_pages on a page or two and describes what it sees
Tells the person the change is live, undoable as one turn, and not saved yet

evals.name: redact-emails-in-a-file
evals.prompt: Redact every email address in ~/work/contract.pdf and give me a separate file.
expected_behavior: Runs pdf find with preset email and path first and reports the count and pages
Runs pdf redact with preset email and the same path, so the input is untouched and contract-redacted.pdf is written beside it
Mentions that redacted pages become pictures

evals.name: pdf-to-powerpoint
evals.prompt: turn slides.pdf into an editable powerpoint
expected_behavior: Uses pdf to_pptx (not a deck tool) with the absolute path
Reports slides, size and text boxes from the answer, and the .pptx path

evals.name: undo-after-mistake
evals.prompt: That crop cut off the header, put it back.
expected_behavior: Calls undo (not a new crop with zero margins)
Renders the page to confirm the header is back
